name: Arlo Essential Indoor 2nd gen (US)

radios.note: Connects directly to a 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network.

matter.note: No Arlo page we found lists Matter for this camera.

apple_home.note: Arlo's pages conflict: the US product page says Apple Home support is still in the works, while Arlo's HomeKit FAQ says Arlo devices reach Apple Home only through a SmartHub or Base Station, with a device list that varies by region.

google_home.note: Retailers and Arlo's 3rd gen FAQ list Google Assistant, and Arlo's Google Assistant FAQ names camera families, but we found no Arlo page that lists this 2nd gen indoor camera.

alexa.note: Arlo says all Arlo cameras work with the Arlo Alexa skill; 'Alexa, show me [camera]' streams on Echo Show, Echo Spot and Fire TV. Last-motion playback needs a subscription or trial.

smartthings.note: Arlo's blog says Arlo cameras work with SmartThings but names no model here.

home_assistant.note: No official Arlo or Home Assistant page for this camera found.

hubRequired.note: Connects straight to Wi-Fi with no SmartHub or Base Station. Arlo's product page says it can also be added to a SmartHub or Base Station.

localControl.note: Not stated; control runs through the Arlo Secure app and cloud.

power.note: Retailers list a corded plug-in adapter; no maker page we could open states it.

localStorage.note: No slot on the camera. Arlo says it now works with a SmartHub or Base Station, which offer local storage, but we found no Arlo page confirming local recording for this camera.

subscription.value: Arlo Secure for premium features after the 30-day trial
subscription.note: A 30-day Arlo Secure trial is included; Arlo says a paid plan is needed to keep premium features after it. Continuous recording needs a separate CVR plan.

summary: The Arlo Essential Indoor Camera (2nd Generation) is a plug-in indoor camera with a 130 degree view and an automated privacy shield over the lens. It connects to 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi without a hub and works with Alexa through the Arlo skill. Premium features need an Arlo Secure plan after the trial. Apple Home and Google Home support are unconfirmed for this model.
caveats: Premium features need an Arlo Secure subscription after the 30-day trial; continuous recording is a separate plan.
Sold in HD (VMC2060) and 2K versions; this record covers the 2nd gen line as Arlo's FAQ does.
The privacy shield closes automatically when you disarm the camera.
